North Dakota Statewide Parcels
North Dakota Statewide Parcels
« All News
Friday, July 16, 2021 - 11:15 am
Categories: Other Data
The statewide parcel dataset is now available from the North Dakota GIS Hub. It has been a group effort with people from the counties, county vendors, multiple state agencies, AppGeo, and the North Dakota Association of Counties all working together in various capacities and times, from the beginning of the RFP development through the information and data gathering phases, and to the completion. This dataset would not have been possible without the funding provided by the 66th Legislative Assembly.
The parcel dataset is already beginning to be used by state agencies. The 67th Legislative Assembly has provided funding for the maintenance and enhancement of the systems and data that support the parcel dataset. More information including how to access this data can be found on the State Parcel Program website.
